understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by matching the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation to each goal cell, then stepping onto the matching goal.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement consumes stamina, and walls block movement. Shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. A goal activates only when all three attributes match. Reaching zero stamina costs a life and resets stamina; losing all lives ends the game.
